summary: Read plain text from the selected clipboard.

target.notes: Use a native clipboard service; preserve Electron type selection and data-format behavior.

caveats: The Linux selection clipboard is distinct from the normal clipboard.
Renderer direct clipboard use is deprecated; process restrictions should be checked by analysis.

tests.name: linux selection
tests.expected_behavior: reads the Linux selection clipboard where available; unsupported platforms must not silently alias it without an explicit compatibility policy
